Definition: , or neuter τετρακόσια plural from G5064 and G1540; four hundred:--four hundred.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tetrakósioi where it means four hundred. In Acts 5:36, about four hundred, joined themselves, and it appears again in Galatians 3:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe four hundred still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
